power_procedure.name: Nested clustered equivalence and misspecification simulation for birth cells
power_procedure.operating_characteristic: Proposal: require >=0.90 full-conjunction admission probability under prospectively named in-margin scenarios (including exact agreement and reviewer-chosen near-margin profiles), with a simulation interval precise enough for the review. Effect sizes, tolerances and cell family must be frozen before outcomes. Separately estimate false-admission probability for prespecified out-of-margin profiles; no admission or inconclusive alone is not evidence the procedure detects a wrong mechanism. No power demonstrated.
inputs: Pinned critical-cell event/exposure sizes or blinded authorized counts; same-year vintage/rounding allowances; design effects and covariance; fitted-law/parity uncertainty; OP5/OP3 clustering; simulation seed variance.
procedure: Run an invented-data effective-size/design-effect grid; perturb one age/sex profile at a time and jointly; refit only development data.
Nest survey/fitted-law resampling and repeated projection seeds, form Bonferroni simultaneous bounds, estimate the full-conjunction probability and binomial Monte Carlo interval.
Freeze required effective sizes, alternatives and pooling ladder prospectively; absence of matched counts or >=0.90 support blocks feasibility approval.
power_procedure.hypotheses: For frozen empirical cells j with discrepancy d_j=|ln(C_j/R_j)| and prospective tolerance delta_j: H0 is at least one d_j >= delta_j; H1 is all d_j < delta_j. A separately registered absolute discrepancy replaces log ratio for zero cells. Full-conjunction admission power is P(all simultaneous intervals inside their margins) under a named in-margin alternative, not probability of inconclusive.
